[[General/Legends|General]] '''Skylast''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was stationed in the [[Belsavis prison]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he coordinated the defense of the [[Maximum Security Section]] against an assault by the [[Esh-kha]]. He tasked a Republic citizen with striking against key strategic points of the Esh-kha forces and later advised him on the matter of the [[World Razer]]. The individual proved their worth and both the Esh-kha and World Razer were prevented from leaving the planet.

Sometime later, he was contacted by [[Republic Marshall]] [[Kay Cavarat]] to send troops to apprehend [[crime lord]] [[Ivory]], which he gladly did.
